chalisa.cau1: Victory, victory, victory to you, Mother Lalitā; your virtues and glory are renowned. ॥1॥
chalisa.cau2: You are the beautiful goddess Tripureśvarī; gods, men and sages serve at your feet. ॥2॥
chalisa.cau3: You are the auspicious one who removes hardship; you are the giver of joy who takes away calamity. ॥3॥
chalisa.cau4: You destroy delusion and slay demons; you cherish your devotees and make the light shine. ॥4॥
chalisa.cau5: You are the primal Power, in the form of Śrīvidyā, sovereign of the cakra, incomparable in body. ॥5॥
chalisa.cau6: You dwell in the heart and carry your devotees across; you take away hosts of hardships and calamities of every kind. ॥6॥
chalisa.cau7: The ten Mahāvidyās are your form; Śrī Candreśvarī, Naimiṣa is dear to you. ॥7॥
chalisa.cau8: Dhūmāvatī, Bagalā, Bhairavī, Tārā, Bhuvaneśvarī and Kamalā are your unfolding. ॥8॥
chalisa.cau9: Ṣoḍaśī, Chinnamastā and Mātaṅgī: Lalitā, these powers are your companions. ॥9॥
chalisa.cau10: Lalitā, your forehead is radiant; you have taken care of your devotees' work. ॥10॥
chalisa.cau11: Whenever great dangers came, you saved your devotees from them. ॥11॥
chalisa.cau12: Whoever won your grace found all things go well for him in every way. ॥12॥
chalisa.cau13: Mother, take away this great hardship; your devotees put their hope in you. ॥13॥
chalisa.cau14: Tripureśvarī, Śailajā, Bhavānī, victory, victory, victory to you, great queen of Śiva. ॥14॥
chalisa.cau15: All yogīs attain perfection in yoga; enjoyers enjoy their pleasures and great happiness. ॥15॥
chalisa.cau16: Mother, when one receives your grace, life becomes full of joy. ॥16॥
chalisa.cau17: You have taken the suffering as your own; a great fool is he who has not come to your refuge. ॥17॥
chalisa.cau18: Whomever you looked upon received wealth and every happiness. ॥18॥
chalisa.cau19: Primal Power, beloved of the three worlds, victory to you; great Power, remover of fear, victory, victory to you. ॥19॥
chalisa.cau20: You are the Kulayoginī, in the form of Kuṇḍalinī; Lalitā, you play an incomparable divine play. ॥20॥
chalisa.cau21: Mahāmaheśvarī, give great power; Tripurasundarī, give devotion always. ॥21॥
chalisa.cau22: Great Mahānandā, bestower of good, you give speech to those who cannot speak. ॥22॥
chalisa.cau23: A sharer in will, knowledge and action is the one who loves to serve you. ॥23॥
chalisa.cau24: Lalitā, whoever sings your virtues is troubled by no hardship. ॥24॥
chalisa.cau25: All-auspicious one, Jvālāmālinī, wreathed in flames, you are the mover of all powers. ॥25॥
chalisa.cau26: Mother, whoever came to your refuge had all his calamities taken away. ॥26॥
chalisa.cau27: You are Nāmākarṣiṇī and Cittākarṣiṇī, who draw the name and the mind; Sarvamohinī, who enchants all, and you shower every joy. ॥27॥
chalisa.cau28: Your glory is renowned throughout the world; you are the compassionate Mother of the world. ॥28॥
chalisa.cau29: Lalitā, giver of all good fortune, you are the giver of joy, full of compassion. ॥29॥
chalisa.cau30: You give bliss, happiness and wealth; you take away terrible hardships. ॥30॥
chalisa.cau31: One who meditates on you from the heart at once obtains what his heart desires. ॥31॥
chalisa.cau32: You are Lakṣmī, Durgā and Kālī; you are Śāradā, and the bearer of the discus and the skull. ॥32॥
chalisa.cau33: Dweller in the mūlādhāra, victory, victory to you; Mother who rises to the sahasrāra, victory, victory to you. ॥33॥
chalisa.cau34: You pierce the six cakras and keep watch over all. ॥34॥
chalisa.cau35: Yogīs and enjoyers, the wrathful and the lustful: all are your servants, all your followers. ॥35॥
chalisa.cau36: Mother, you carry all across; Mother, you show mercy to all. ॥36॥
chalisa.cau37: You are Haimavatī, Umā and Brahmāṇī, who tore apart the heart of Bhaṇḍāsura. ॥37॥
chalisa.cau38: Remover of every calamity, support of all, you have delivered the crooked and those on evil paths. ॥38॥
chalisa.cau39: Bearer of the moon, dweller at Naimiṣa, show grace, Lalitā, destroyer of sins. ॥39॥
chalisa.cau40: Grant your devotees the sight of you; swiftly wipe out all doubt and fear. ॥40॥
chalisa.cau41: Whoever reads the Lalitā Chālīsā becomes the master of happiness and bliss. ॥41॥
chalisa.cau42: Whoever is struck by any hardship, let him recite it, and the hardship vanishes. ॥42॥
chalisa.cau43: Whoever reads it twenty-one times with mind intent has every wish fulfilled. ॥43॥
chalisa.cau44: Those without a son find the joy of children; the poor, singing your virtues, become rich. ॥44॥
chalisa.cau45: Whoever recites it in this way is freed from the bonds of sorrow, and happiness comes. ॥45॥
chalisa.cau46: Jitendra Candra Bhāratīya says: if people read the Chālīsā, they will find happiness. ॥46॥
chalisa.cau47: Know this as the simplest means of all: whatever you resolve on in your mind will be accomplished. ॥47॥
chalisa.cau48: Lalitā makes her dwelling in the heart; the Lalitā Chālīsā grants accomplishment. ॥48॥
chalisa.do1: Mother Lalitā, show grace now and bring every work to fulfilment. With faith we bow our heads and offer you our salutations.
